financial_unit: millions unless explicitly shares or EPS
limitations: All FY24-FY26 and historical TTM periods contain 52 weeks; FY27 guidance is a separate 53-week outlook.

Quarter CF values not reported separately are YTD differences; Q4 income is reported in the annual earnings release; Q4 CF is annual less nine months. Differences of rounded filings can differ from reported quarter by $1m.
No quarter weighted-share inference. Q4 weighted shares/EPS are reported in the annual earnings release; TTM weighted shares/EPS left null.
September 26 balance includes JRD prefunding and excludes subsequent October financing and unclosed acquisition. It is not November pro forma net debt.
Acquisition intangible amortization excludes acquisition diligence/costs; do not substitute total non-GAAP D&A adjustment.
CFO is after interest, cash taxes and working capital; CFO-capex is not unlevered FCFF.
Pension detail remains in dimensioned source observations; unavailable quarterly contributions are not zero.
